origin.usage: stri_replace_all_fixed(str, pattern, replacement, vectorize_all = TRUE, vectorise_all = vectorize_all, ..., opts_fixed = NULL)

arguments.name: str
arguments.text: Character vector of strings to search.

arguments.name: vectorize_all
arguments.text: If TRUE, recycle str, pattern, and replacement together. If FALSE, apply each pattern to every string.

arguments.name: vectorise_all
arguments.text: Alias of vectorize_all. When supplied, it wins.

arguments.name: opts_fixed
arguments.text: Search settings. The installed function ignores overlap.

origin.details: With vectorize_all FALSE, pattern must be at least as long as replacement. A missing or empty pattern then makes the whole result NA. Overlap does not change the result: aaa with pattern aa and replacement b becomes ba. An empty string stays empty. A missing opts_fixed uses case-sensitive search without overlap. A dict may set case_insensitive and overlap. Case-insensitive search maps each code point with ICU u_toupper. A character whose uppercase form is longer than one code point is left unchanged, so ß does not match SS.
origin.example:
found <- stri_replace_all_fixed("aAaA", "a", "X", case_insensitive = TRUE)
cat(paste0('stri_replace_all_fixed("aAaA", "a", "X", case_insensitive=TRUE) returns ', found, '.\n'))

translation.usage: stri_replace_all_fixed(str, pattern, replacement, vectorize_all=True, vectorise_all=None, opts_fixed=None, case_insensitive=None, overlap=None)

arguments.name: str
arguments.text: String, missing value, or list of those.

arguments.name: pattern
arguments.text: Literal pattern, missing value, or list of those.

arguments.name: replacement
arguments.text: Text that replaces each match. NA makes a matched string missing.

arguments.name: vectorize_all
arguments.text: If true, recycle the three arguments together. If false, apply each pattern to every string.

arguments.name: vectorise_all
arguments.text: Alias of vectorize_all. When given, it wins.

arguments.name: opts_fixed
arguments.text: None, or a dict of search settings. Overlap is ignored.

arguments.name: case_insensitive
arguments.text: If given, match the simple uppercase of each code point.

translation.details: With vectorize_all false, pattern must be at least as long as replacement. A missing or empty pattern then makes the whole result NA. Overlap does not change the result: aaa with pattern aa and replacement b becomes ba. An empty string stays empty. A missing opts_fixed uses case-sensitive search without overlap. A dict may set case_insensitive and overlap. Case-insensitive search maps each code point with ICU u_toupper. A character whose uppercase form is longer than one code point is left unchanged, so ß does not match SS.
translation.value: A list of strings and NA.
translation.example:
from stringi.fixed import stri_replace_all_fixed
found = stri_replace_all_fixed("aAaA", "a", "X", case_insensitive=True)
print(f'stri_replace_all_fixed("aAaA", "a", "X", case_insensitive=True) returns {found[0]}.')
